AgileHand.CriticalFailureNote: Si tú critically fail, el conjuro ends and puedes't use this modification again for 24 horas.
AgileHand.Description: Cuando tú cast _telekinetic hand_, puedes modify its target to be a set of thieves' tools. Cuando tú Lanzar el conjuro in this way, the tools move up to 20 pies towards a device or lock. After tú Sustain el conjuro on future turns, puedes use the tools to attempt Thievery checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} within el conjuro's range, but sufres a -2 penalización to tu Thievery check. Si tú critically fail, el conjuro ends and puedes't use this modification again for 24 horas.

AnimateNet.Description: Cuando tú cast _animate rope_, puedes modify its target to be 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.T8EopYZLT137CsdW]{Net}. Si tú do, replace el conjuro's standard effects with the following: Provocas a net to animate and throw itself at a Medium or smaller criatura within 20 pies of the net. Attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque against el objetivo's Reflex DC. On a success, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} and takes a -10-pies penalización de circunstancia to its Velocidades until it Escapes; on a critical success, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} until it Escapes. El Escape DC is equal to tu conjuro DC as long as el conjuro lasts. Once el conjuro ends, the Escape DC returns to the normal DC for a net (usually 16), and a criatura adjacent to el objetivo can Interactuar to remove the net.

BarrierShield.Description: Cuando tú cast _shield_, puedes modify el conjuro to create a solid barrier puedes use for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Cover}, but not for blocking. Puedes't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction when el conjuro is modified in this way, but tú (and only tú) can spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} to gain standard cover from it.

BeaconMark.Description: Cuando tú cast _sigil_, puedes modify el conjuro to add the following heightened entry.
BeaconMark.DescriptionHeightened: Te armonizas to the marked target. While el conjuro lasts, puedes spend a single action, which has the concentrate, detection, and divination rasgos, to attempt to locate el objetivo, learning the direction to el objetivo as long as estás within 1 mile of it. Si el objetivo is a criatura or a criatura is in possession of el objetivo object, the criatura can attempt a @Check[type:will] tirada de salvación against tu conjuro DC. Si it succeeds, tu attempt to locate el objetivo fails and puedes't attempt this again for 1 día. Puedes only have a single target marked with a _sigil_ modified in this way. Si tú Cast this Spell again on a second target, the _sigil_ conjuro on the first target ends, and tu mark fades.

ChokingSmoke.Description: Cuando tú cast _fireball_ heightened to at least 6th rank, puedes modify el conjuro's standard effects as follows: Reduce el conjuro's daño by 6d6. Tu _fireball_ leaves behind a lingering cloud of toxic smoke in its area. While it's smoke instead of mist, this cloud otherwise has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GKpEcy9WId6NJvtx]{Stinking Cloud}.

ConfoundingImage.Description: Cuando tú cast _mirror image_, puedes modify its duration to be sustained up to 1 minuto and modify its range to 30 pies. Si tú do, replace el conjuro's standard effects with the following: Creas an illusory duplicate of yourself that appears in an unoccupied square within range. El image takes up space and has a reach of 5 pies, and tu aliados can flank with the image. It doesn't have any other attributes a criatura would normally have other than an CA equal to tu conjuro DC and tirada de salvación modifiers equal to tu conjuro DC – 10. Si the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, or if tú ever move more than 30 pies from it, el conjuro ends. Las criaturas can move through its space without hindrance. Cuando tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move the image to an unoccupied square within range.

DirectedPoison.Description: Cuando tú cast _toxic cloud_, modify its duration to be sustained up to 1 minuto, and modify its standard effect to include the following: El cloud doesn't move away from tú each round. Una vez por asalto when tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move the cloud 10 pies in the direction of tu choice.

DiskRider.Description: Cuando tú cast _floating disk_, puedes modify its duration to be sustained, up to 10 minutos. Si tú do, add the following heightened entry to its effects.
DiskRider.DescriptionHeightened: El disk can hold up to 10 Bulk. El conjuro no longer ends if tú ride atop the disk (though it does if any other criatura rides atop it, including if the criatura is riding on tú). Si estás riding the disk, it changes its capacity to hold tú, plus additional Bulk equal to the maximum tú could carry without being encumbered. Si tú ride atop the disk, puedes direct it to move along the ground up to 30 pies or tu Velocidad, whichever is slower, each time tú Sustain the Spell. While tú ride atop it, the disk can move over liquids as long as it ends its movement on solid ground. Si it ends its movement on a surface that can't support it, el conjuro ends.

DrenchingMist.Description: Cuando tú cast _mist_, puedes modify it to add the following heightened entry to its effects.
DrenchingMist.DescriptionHeightened: Tu _mist_ is particularly laden with moisture. Non-magical fires within the area are automatically extinguished. Elige one magical fire or fire conjuro in the area and attempt to counteract it.

ForcefulPush.Description: Cuando tú cast _telekinetic hand_, puedes modify its target to be 1 criatura. Si tú do, replace its standard effects with the following: Empujas tu foe telekinetically. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against el objetivo's Fortitude DC. On a success, tú push el objetivo 5 pies away from tú. On a critical success, tú push el objetivo 10 pies away from tú.

LarcenousHand.Description: Cuando tú cast _telekinetic hand_, puedes remove its duration, modify its range to 20 pies, and modify its target to be an attended object within el conjuro's Bulk limit that wouldn't be time-consuming to remove. Add the following to el conjuro's standard effects: Si the criatura attending the object is willing to have sufres the item, Telekinetic Hand carries the item to tú. Si the criatura is unwilling, debes attempt to [[/act steal]] el objetivo object with a Thievery check. El usual restrictions on attempts to Steal an object apply, including the restrictions that puedes't steal objects that would be extremely noticeable or time-consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor or actively wielded objects) and puedes't Steal from a criatura in combat or otherwise on guard. On a successful Steal check, the Telekinetic Hand carries the item to tú, and on a critical failure, puedes't use this modification again for 1 hora. Si estás a maestro in Thievery, puedes attempt to Steal from a criatura in combat or otherwise on guard, though if tú do so, el conjuro's casting time increases by 1 action.

LingeringFlames.Description: Cuando tú cast _fireball_, puedes modify its effects, decreasing the base daño a 5d6 and causing it to deal @Damage[(2*(@item.level - 2))[fire,persistent]] daño a criaturas that fail their save, doubled as normal on a critical failure. Si tú do, replace its heightened entry with the following.
LingeringFlames.DescriptionHeightened: El daño is increased by 1d6 and the daño persistente de fuego is increased by 2.

ObscuredTerrain.Description: Cuando tú cast _mist_, puedes modify el conjuro to replace its standard effects with the following: Provocas a cloud of thick fog to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground. El area within the fog is difficult terrain for criaturas that can't see through fog or mist. Puedes Dismiss the cloud.

ScatteredFire.Description: Cuando tú cast _fireball_, puedes modify its area to be two non-overlapping @Template[type:burst|distance:10]{10-pies bursts}.

ShiningArms.Description: Cuando tú cast _light_, puedes modify its target to be 1 melee arma, either unattended or possessed by tú or a willing aliado, and modify its duration to be 1 minuto. Si tú do, add the following to its effects: Cuando a criatura wielding the arma critically hits a foe, puedes Dismiss the Spell as a reaction, causing the foe to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} durante 1 asalto. After tú use this reaction, puedes't use this modification again for 10 minutos.
ShiningArms.Label: brazos brillantes
ShiningArms.Note: Cuando a criatura wielding the arma critically hits a foe, puedes Dismiss el conjuro as a reaction, causing the foe to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} durante 1 asalto.

SiphoningTouch.Description: Cuando tú cast _vampiric feast_, puedes modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the Puntos de Golpe temporales yourself, puedes grant the Puntos de Golpe temporales to an aliado within 30 pies. After 1 minuto, the aliado loses any of these Puntos de Golpe temporales that remain.

SmolderingExplosion.Description: Cuando tú cast _fireball_ heightened to at least 4th rank, puedes modify el conjuro to add the following to its standard effects: Tu _fireball_ leaves behind a brief cloud of smoke in its area. While it's smoke instead of mist, this cloud otherwise has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, except that it lasts only 1 asalto.

StealVitality.Description: Cuando tú cast _vampiric feast_, puedes modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining Puntos de Golpe temporales, if tu target fails or critically fails its tirada de salvación, puedes attempt a counteract check to remove the torpe or debilitado estados on yourself, using the source of that estado to determine the counteract rank and DC. Si the estado was caused by an ongoing effect and tú don't remove that effect, the estado returns at the end of tu next turn.

SummonEnsemble.Description: Cuando tú cast _summon instrument_, puedes modify its duration to be sustained, up to 1 minuto. Cuando tú do, tú summon a number of instruments equal to tu spellcasting ability modifier that hover around tú and play of their own accord. Once per turn when tú Sustain the Spell, elige an opponent within 30 pies who can hear tu performance. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:will] salvación against el conjuro's DC; on a failure, it becomes distracted by tu performance and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} durante 1 asalto. El objetivo is then temporarily immune for 24 horas.

SurroundingFlames.Description: Cuando tú cast _wall of fire_, puedes modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of a 5-pies-thick, 10-pies-radius ring of flame, puedes form the wall into a @Template[type:burst|distance:10]{10-pies-radius} hemisphere of fire.

TopplingTentacles.Description: Cuando tú cast _black tentacles_, replace el conjuro's standard effects with the following: Tentacles slither along the ground in the area, attempting to hinder anyone within. Sticky black tentacles attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} each criatura in the area. Attempt conjuro tiradas de ataque against the Reflex DCs of each affected criatura. Any criatura tú succeed against is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} and takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] daño. Siempre que a criatura ends its turn in the area, the tentacles attempt to Trip that criatura if it isn't already prone, and they deal @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño a any criatura already prone. Las criaturas treat el conjuro's area as difficult terrain.

TracingSigil.Description: Cuando tú cast _sigil_, puedes modify el conjuro to add the following to its standard effects: El objetivo leaves a magical trail that tú and others can try to follow. Tú y other criaturas can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} el objetivo, substituting an Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check (whichever matches the magical tradition of tu _sigil_ conjuro) for the Survival check. Much like Tracking with Survival, this must take place somewhere el objetivo has been and follow the trail; it doesn't allow anyone to find el objetivo from a distance. Puedes only have a single target marked with a modified _sigil_ in this way. Si tú use this ability again on a second target, the _sigil_ conjuro on the first target ends, and tu mark fades.

UneasyRest.Description: Cuando lanzas dormir, puedes modificar el hechizo para agregar lo siguiente a sus efectos estándar: Los sujetos de tu hechizo experimentan sueños perturbados. Cuando un objetivo que falló o falló críticamente su tirada de salvación se despierta, es @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} .

VolatileGrease.CriticalSuccess: El objetivo no ha sido afectado
VolatileGrease.Description: Cuando tú cast _grease_, puedes modify its target to be 1 criatura. Si tú do, replace el conjuro's standard effects with the following: Salpicas el objetivo with combustible grease. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:reflex] salvación.
VolatileGrease.Fallo: As success, except the weakness to fire lasts durante 1 minuto.
VolatileGrease.Éxito: El objetivo is splattered with grease and gains weakness 2 to fire until the end of tu next turn. El objetivo or an adjacent criatura can rub off the combustible grease with an Interactuar action, ending the effect.

WildLights.Description: Cuando tú cast _light_, puedes modify its duration to be 1 minuto and modify its standard effects to create a single floating light in the shape of a Tiny criatura, instead of up to four floating lights. El criatura hovers over tu head unless tú spend a single action that has the concentrate rasgo to direct the light to move up to 30 pies, in which case it remains there until tú direct it again. Si tú direct it back to tu head, it hovers there and follows tú again until tú direct it elsewhere. Si the light ever moves beyond 120 pies of tú, it winks out immediately.

BeastmastersSigil.AdjacentLabel: Objetivo adyacente a la invocación del sello del maestro de bestias

CriticalHitNote.GreaterOrMajor: El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of its next turn.
CriticalHitNote.Weapon: El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn.

SpellmastersResilience.Prompt: Selecciona una tradición mágica para ganar resistencia.

Spellshape.BizzareTransformation: Si tu next action is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form}, puedes change the tipo de daño of a single ataque sin armas granted by the untamed form form to one of the following: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, poison, piercing, or slashing. El chosen attack gains the appropriate rasgo.
Spellshape.BloodlineConduit: No gastas el conjuro's slot when tú cast it.
Spellshape.BondConservation: Obtienes an extra use of Drain Bonded Item. Puedes use it to cast a conjuro 2 or more ranks lower than the previous conjuro, and must use it before the end of tu next turn or tú lose it.
Spellshape.BurningSpell: El conjuro deals @Damage[(@item.rank)[persistent,fire]] in addition to its other effects. Esto has no effect if el conjuro already deals daño persistente de fuego. El conjuro gains the fire rasgo
Spellshape.CallAndResponse: While el conjuro is active, one aliado of tu choice affected by el conjuro can respond to tu call as a single action that has the auditory and concentrate rasgos to extend el conjuro's duration by 1 asalto. Only one aliado can respond to a given call, and responding to the aliado's response has no additional effect.
Spellshape.CastDown: El objetivo is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if it takes any daño de el conjuro. Si el objetivo critically fails its save against el conjuro, it also takes a –10-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidad durante 1 minuto. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Ve1CRFI8ikL6dqcL]{Efecto: Cast Down}

ChaoticSpell.acid: Each criatura damaged by el conjuro becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
ChaoticSpell.cold: Each criatura damaged by el conjuro takes a –10-pies penalización to all Velocidades until the end of tu next turn.
ChaoticSpell.electricity: Each criatura damaged by el conjuro is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the end of tu next turn
ChaoticSpell.fire: Each criatura damaged by el conjuro takes @Damage[(@item.rank)[persistent,fire]] daño.
ChaoticSpell.sonic: Eah criatura damaged by el conjuro is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} durante 2 asaltos.

Note.destruction: El conjuro ignores 10 resistance and tú reroll any dados de daño that roll a 1. Si el conjuro reduces a criatura to 0 Puntos de Golpe, they're torn apart at an infinitesimal level, not even leaving a fine ash; this is a death effect.
Note.renewal: El conjuro grants el objetivo regeneration 20, restoring 20 Puntos de Golpe at the start of its turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.yZW8I6G2Di6gdd16]{Efecto: Codex of Destruction and Renewal}

Spellshape.ConcealSpell: El conjuro gains the subtle rasgo, hiding the shining runes, sparks of magic, and other manifestations that would usually give away tu spellcasting. El rasgo hides only el conjuro's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects, so an observer might still see a ray streak out from tú or see tú vanish into thin air.
Spellshape.CourageousAdvance: One aliado of tu choice who gains a bonificador de estado from el conjuro can immediately use their reaction to Zancada.
Spellshape.CourageousAssault: One aliado of tu choice who gains a bonificador de estado from el conjuro can immediately use their reaction to make a melee Golpe.
Spellshape.CourageousOnslaught: One aliado of tu choice who gains a bonificador de estado from el conjuro can immediately use their reaction to Zancada and then make a melee Golpe.
Spellshape.CrypticSpell: Si the next action sufres is to Lanzar un conjuro, attempt a Nature check against all observers' Perception DCs. Si tú succeed at tu check against an observer's Perception DC, that observer doesn't notice that estás Lanzando un conjuro, even though verbal, somatic, and material components are usually noticeable, and conjuros normally have sensory manifestations that would make spellcasting obvious to those nearby. All of these are instead hidden in the natural sights and sounds of the environment. Esto ability hides only el conjuro's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects, so an observer might still see tú transform into a giant bear.
Spellshape.CurrentSpell: Until the start of tu next turn, obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to CA or a +2 bonificador de circunstancia against ranged attacks. Esto effect has the air or water rasgo, or both, depending on the rasgos of el conjuro tú cast. También obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to all salvaciones contra effects with the selected rasgo, depending on el conjuro's rasgos. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.8HGz3rQCHNgdAqFC]{Efecto: Current Spell}
Spellshape.DefensiveCoordination: Puedes Alzar un escudo, and one aliado of tu choice who gains a bonificador de estado from el conjuro can immediately use their reaction to Alzar un escudo.
Spellshape.DefensiveRecovery: Si el objetivo regains Puntos de Golpe from el conjuro, it also gains a +2 bonificador de estado to CA and tiradas de salvación durante 1 asalto. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jwxurN6JPQm9wXug]{Efecto: Defensive Recovery}
Spellshape.DivineInfusion: El objetivo deals daño adicional with its melee armas and ataques sin armas until the end of its next turn. El tipo de daño es void if tú cast harm and vitality if tú cast heal. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eecIuD6sGPX0FJcT]{Efecto: Divine Infusion}.
Spellshape.DousingSpell: Empapas el objetivo of el conjuro with water. Si el objetivo has persistent acid or daño de fuego, the DC to end those estados is reduced to 10, and the criatura can attempt a prueba plana to end those types of daño persistente immediately. El conjuro gains the water rasgo (causing it to deal daño adicional a criaturas with weakness to water).
Spellshape.EbbAndFlow: Elige one criatura in range that would be harmed by el conjuro, and elige another criatura within range that would be healed by el conjuro. Tu heal or harm targets both criaturas.
Spellshape.EchoingSpell: Puedes Lanzar el conjuro a second time before the end of tu next turn without expending a conjuro slot.
Spellshape.EchoingChannel: Elige una criatura adicional dentro del alcance. Target that criatura with a 1-action version of the same conjuro. Esto conjuro is the same rank as the 2-action harm or heal tú cast and doesn't cost another conjuro slot
Spellshape.EnergyAblation: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that deals at least one type of daño de energía (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), obtienes resistance to an energy tipo de daño of tu choice equal to el conjuro's rank. El resistance lasts until the end of tu next turn. Obtienes the resistance regardless of whether or not tu conjuro dealt daño.
Spellshape.EnergyFusion: Select a non-cantrip conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire that deals a different type of daño de energía, and expend an additional conjuro slot of the same rank as this secondary conjuro. El conjuro tú cast deals daño adicional equal to the rank of the secondary conjuro slot expended. El conjuro's total daño is divided evenly between the energy type of el conjuro tú cast and the energy type of the secondary conjuro.
Spellshape.ExplosiveArrival: All criaturas in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the criatura tú summoned take @Damage[(@item.level)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.spellshape.explosiveArrivalDamage]|options:area-damage] daño. Si the criatura summoned has the acid, cold, electricity, sonic, or spirit rasgo, puedes deal daño of that type instead.
Spellshape.FamiliarsResolve: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro, tú or an aliado within 30 pies gain a +2 bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación against effects that would cause tú to be doomed or asustado durante 1 asalto. At 14th level, tú or an aliado gain a +3 bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación against these effects instead. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.6I4qWkHzxj4MAt6g]{Efecto: Familiar's Resolve}
Spellshape.ForcibleEnergy: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or daño sónico, puedes select one target that was damaged to gain weakness 5 to that tipo de daño until the end of tu next turn. Si a conjuro deals multiple types of daño de energía, elige one that el objetivo gains weakness to. Esto has no effect on criaturas with resistance or immunity to the energy type tú elige. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.0Ai0u9kNJrEudPnN]{Efecto: Forcible Energy}
Spellshape.FormControl: El conjuro's rank is 2 lower than normal (minimum 1st rank), but puedes remain transformed for up to 1 hora or the listed duration (whichever is longer). Puedes still Dismiss untamed form as normal.
Spellshape.GarlandSpell: A garland of plants grows in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] in el conjuro's range. El plants are difficult terrain and hazardous terrain, covered in tu choice of thorns or poisonous vines. Any criatura that moves into one of these squares or ends its turn in one takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]]daño for thorns or @Damage[2d6[poison]] for vines. A criatura can take this daño only once per turn. Tú y tu familiar are immune to this daño. El plants last durante 1 minuto or until tú cast another Garland Spell, whichever comes first. El daño increases to 3d6 at 16th level and 4d6 at 20th level.
Spellshape.GoldenDragonsBounty: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro that deals bludgeoning, piercing, or daño cortante, that daño is tu choice of cold iron, silver, or steel for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, vulnerabilities, and the like. At 14th level, adamantine is added to the list of metal choices. El conjuro gains the metal rasgo.
Spellshape.GrowthSpell: Expand the area of el conjuro. For bursts, expand the radius by 5 pies; for cones, expand the cone by 10 pies; and for lines, expand the length by 15 pies. El conjuro gains the wood rasgo.
Spellshape.GustingSpell: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro with the air or electricity rasgo, puedes Fly up to 10 pies before or after el conjuro is cast.
Spellshape.Harmonize: Si tu next action is to cast a composition, it becomes a harmonized composition. Unlike a normal composition, a harmonized composition doesn't end if tú cast another composition, and puedes cast another composition on the same turn as a harmonized one. Casting another harmonized composition ends any harmonized composition tú already have in effect.
Spellshape.HealingTransformation: Tu conjuro de polimorfia also restores @Damage[(@item.rank)d6[healing]] to that criatura. Esto is a healing effect.
Spellshape.HeraldicProclamation: All aliados within 30 pies gain @Damage[(2 * @item.rank)[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Puntos de Golpe, and all enemies within 30 pies take @Damage[(2 * @item.rank)[spirit]|traits:sanctified] daño with a @Check[will|basic] salvación against tu conjuro DC.
Spellshape.HeroicRecovery: El objetivo gains three bonuses until the end of its next turn: a +5-pies bonificador de estado to its Velocidad, a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de ataque, and a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño. In addition, if el objetivo is Prone, it can immediately Stand as a free action that no desencadena reacciones.
Spellshape.InTune: Si tu next action is casting a composition conjuro with an emanation area, its area spreads from a willing aliado of tu choice within 60 pies instead of tú. Si tienes Directed Audience, puedes have that cone originate from the aliado instead.
Spellshape.InterweaveDispel: Si tu next action is to cast a single-target conjuro against an enemigo, and tú either hit the enemigo with el conjuro tirada de ataque or the enemigo fails its tirada de salvación, puedes cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} on the enemigo as a free action, expending a conjuro slot as normal and targeting one conjuro effect affecting the enemigo.
Spellshape.IntoTheFuture: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast, el conjuro's effects occur 1 asalto later, at the beginning of tu next turn, rather than immediately. Targets and choices about el conjuro must be determined when el conjuro is cast, and requirements, such as line of sight and line of effect, must be valid both when el conjuro is cast and when its effects occur. Consequences for the action of Casting the Spell itself, such as an Attack of Opportunity reaction or ending a foe's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado} estado by taking a hostile action, aren't delayed.

KaleidoscopicEntreaty.Description: Si tu next action is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Yph1UqZU8vMc9bJG]{Entreat Spirit}, puedes cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on tú. Each criatura in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] salvación against tu class DC or conjuro DC with the following results.
KaleidoscopicEntreaty.CriticalFailure: El criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} durante 1 asalto and dazzled durante 1 minuto.
KaleidoscopicEntreaty.Fallo: El criatura is dazzled durante 1 minuto.

Spellshape.KnowledgeOfShapes: Usas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BWomK7EVY0WXxWgh]{Reach Spell} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FoWO4RnHRwfEIC7Q]{Widen Spell} as a free action.
Spellshape.LeyLineConduit: No gastas the prepared conjuro as tú cast it.
Spellshape.Martyr: Pierdes @Damage[(@item.rank)d8] Puntos de Golpe, which can't be reduced or mitigated in any way, and tu aliado regains an equal number of Puntos de Golpe.
Spellshape.MelodiousSpell: El conjuro gains the Subtle rasgo. El rasgo hides only el conjuro's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects. As part of using Melodious Spell, puedes elige to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}, or Request. Si tú do so, el conjuro tú cast must have the auditory, emotion, sonic, or visual rasgo to gain the subtle rasgo.
Spellshape.NonLethal: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that deals daño and doesn't have the death or void rasgo, that conjuro gains the nonlethal rasgo.
Spellshape.OstentatiousArrivalManifestEidolon: All criaturas except tú in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around the criatura tú summoned or manifested take @Damage[(@actor.level)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.spellshape.arrivalDamage]|options:area-damage]. Si the criatura tú summoned or manifested has the acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or water rasgo, the daño is that type instead (or daño de frío for the water rasgo). Si the criatura has more than one of these rasgos, tú elige which tipo de daño a deal.
Spellshape.OstentatiousArrivalSummonSpell: All criaturas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around the criatura tú summoned or manifested take @Damage[(@item.level)d4[@actor.flags.pf2e.spellshape.arrivalDamage]|options:area-damage] daño. Si the criatura tú summoned or manifested has the acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or water rasgo, the daño is that type instead (or daño de frío for the water rasgo). Si the criatura has more than one of these rasgos, tú elige which tipo de daño a deal.
Spellshape.OverwhelmingBreath: Si tú use tu next action to Lanzar un conjuro that has the monk rasgo and no duration, el conjuro and any Golpes tú make as a result of casting it ignore an amount of el objetivo's resistance to daño físico equal to tu level.
Spellshape.OverwhelmingEnergy: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro, el conjuro ignores an amount of el objetivo's resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or daño sónico equal to tu level. Esto applies to all daño el conjuro deals, including daño persistente and daño caused by an ongoing effect of el conjuro, such as the wall created by wall of fire. A criatura's immunities are unaffected.
Spellshape.PitchPerfectProjection: Si tu next action this round is to Lanzar un conjuro or use an action that creates an auditory effect with a range, increase that range by 30 pies.
Spellshape.PortentousSpell: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro, any criatura that attempts to use a reaction triggered by tu Lanzar un conjuro activity takes a –2 penalización de circunstancia to tiradas de ataque and pruebas de habilidad rolled as part of the reaction. In addition, if el conjuro includes a conjuro attack or requires a tirada de salvación, criaturas tú hit or that fail their saves are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado} with tú until the start of tu next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.klZVVIetJlR99cT6]{Efecto: Portentous Spell}
Spellshape.PurifyingSpell: Si the next action tú use is to cast _heal_ targeting a single living criatura, puedes attempt to counteract a disease or poison affecting el objetivo, in addition to the other benefits of _heal_. Si tú do, _heal_ gains the water rasgo.
Spellshape.QuickenedCasting: Si tu next action is to cast a cantrip or a conjuro that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank conjuro slot tienes, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).
Spellshape.ReachSpell: Si la siguiente acción que utilizas es Lanzar un conjuro que tiene alcance, incrementa dicho alcance en 30 pies (9 m). Como es habitual cuando se incrementan los alcances de conjuro, si éste tiene normalmente un alcance de toque, lo alargas a 30 pies (9 m).
Spellshape.Remediate: Si tu siguiente acción es usar tu fuente divina para lanzar un conjuro de curar o dañar que requiera 3 acciones, puedes aprovechar la energía residual para contrarrestar fuerzas opuestas. Además de sus efectos normales, usas tu conjuro de curar o dañar para intentar contrarrestar un efecto divino en el área del conjuro.
Spellshape.ReverberatingSpell: El conjuro deals an additional @Damage[1d8[sonic]] daño and all criaturas who fail their save against el conjuro are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido} durante 1 asalto. Targets who critically fail their salvaciones contra this conjuro are instead deafened durante 1 minuto. El conjuro gains the sonic rasgo.
Spellshape.RockslideSpell: (@item.rank) 5-pies squares in the area equal to el conjuro rank become difficult terrain durante 1 asalto. Estos squares must be on the ground, and the entire area of difficult terrain must be contiguous. El conjuro gains the earth rasgo.
Spellshape.SafeguardSpell: Si the next action sufres is to Lanzar un conjuro with an area, tú aren't affected by el conjuro even if estás within the area.
Spellshape.ScintillatingSpell: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that doesn't have the darkness rasgo, has no duration, and requires criaturas to attempt a Reflex save, el conjuro explodes in a spray of scintillating lights, in addition to its other effects. Each criatura that failed its Reflex save against el conjuro is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} durante 1 asalto, and those who critically failed are instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto.
Spellshape.SecondaryDetonationArray: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that deals daño, has no duration, and affects an area, a glowing magic circle appears in a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] within that area. At the beginning of tu next turn, the circle detonates, dealing @Damage[(@item.level)d6[force]] daño a all criaturas within the circle, with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.spellDC.value)]. Si el conjuro dealt a different type of daño, the circle deals @Damage[(@item.level)d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.spellshape.arrayDamage]]{this type of daño instead} (or one type of tu choice if el conjuro could deal multiple types of daño)
Spellshape.SeneschalSpell: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro and tu charge is within 30 pies, puedes have el conjuro originate from tu charge instead. That criatura can use their reaction to roughly complete el conjuro's incantation, which gives el conjuro the subtle rasgo for tú (but not for them) as the manifestation appears solely around tu charge.
Spellshape.SinbladedSpell: Si tú either succeed on tu tirada de ataque or el objetivo fails its tirada de salvación against el conjuro, tú deal @Damage[(@item.rank)[bleed]] daño a el objetivo.
Spellshape.SnowdriftSpell: Select one criatura affected by el conjuro on the ground. Each square on the ground under or adjacent to the criatura fills with ankle-deep snow. Those squares are difficult terrain until the beginning of tu next turn. A criatura can Interactuar to clear a square of snow, and the snow in a square melts if that square is exposed to a fire effect.
Spellshape.SowSpell: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro using 1 action or 2 actions, el conjuro instead plants itself in an adjacent square. Debes make all decisions regarding el conjuro at the time tú cast it. Within the next 10 minutos, puedes direct tu sown conjuro to sprout and produce el conjuro's effects as a reaction, which is triggered when a criatura enters the sown conjuro's space or a square adjacent to it. Puedes have only one sown conjuro at a time, and if tú don't trigger el conjuro within 10 minutos, it dissipates and el conjuro is lost. A criatura can notice the sown conjuro with a successful Perception check against tu conjuro DC.
Spellshape.SpellShroud: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that targets tú, tú surround yourself in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] of dense magical mist that lasts until the start of tu next turn. All criaturas within the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, and all criaturas outside the cloud are concealed to criaturas within it.
Spellshape.SplitHex: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro to cast a harmful hex with a single target, reduce its rank by 2 (making it 2 ranks lower than the maximum conjuro rank puedes cast). Si tú do, puedes select a second target for that hex to affect.
Spellshape.SplitShot: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro without a duration that requires an tirada de ataque against a single target, puedes elige a second target within range. Tiras a single tirada de ataque and compare the result to the CA of both targets. Esto counts as one attack for tu multiple attack penalización. To the second target, el conjuro deals half the amount of daño it would normally deal and has no effects beyond el conjuro's initial daño (such as imposing estados or penalties).
Spellshape.SurgingMight: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro, el conjuro ignores an amount of el objetivo's resistance equal to tu level against the following types of daño: spirit, vitality, and void. Esto applies to all daño el conjuro deals, including daño persistente and daño caused by an ongoing effect of el conjuro. Esto doesn't cause el conjuro to ignore immunities, only resistances.
Spellshape.SynergisticSpell: Puedes Lanzar otro conjuro as a free action. Esto conjuro must be cast from one of tu halcyon conjuro slots.
Spellshape.ThunderclapSpell: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that has the electricity rasgo or deals daño de electricidad, has no duration, and requires criaturas to attempt a tirada de salvación, the force of el conjuro's lightning creates a thunderclap, in addition to its other effects. Each criatura that failed its Reflex save against el conjuro is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido} durante 1 asalto, and those who critically failed are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.
Spellshape.TimelineSplittingSpell: Lanzas dos conjuros that each take 1 or 2 actions to cast. Estos can't be the same conjuro heightened to two different levels. Gastas the resources for both conjuros, such as conjuro slots, Focus Points, and material components. Determine the immediate results for both conjuros, including tiradas de ataque, tiradas de salvación, daño, and any other dice rolls. Then, elige which of the two conjuros takes effect, using the previously made rolls. El other conjuro's resources are still expended, but el conjuro has no effect as the magic disappears the other timeline.
Spellshape.UnlimitedPotential: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro of 5th level or lower that has no duration, tú don't expend the prepared conjuro as tú cast it.
Spellshape.UnusualComposition: Si tu next action is to cast a composition conjuro that is auditory or visual, puedes have it affect criaturas who can witness it with any sense, not just those the rasgos indicate, even including special senses like tremorsense. Puedes elegir to exclude any senses tú elige.
Spellshape.VigorousAnthem: Tú y todos los aliados afectados gain PG temporales equal to 3 + tu Charisma modifier that last durante 1 minuto. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7AzGhIOx4Df5Cicr]{Efecto: Vigorous Anthem}
Spellshape.WhatCouldHaveBeen: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro that summons a criatura, that criatura is another version of tú. Esto criatura remains the type of criatura tú summoned and has largely the same abilities (plus the following adjustments), but it clearly resembles tú, likely sharing some distinguishing features, such as mannerisms, speech patterns, tattoos, or clothing. El summoned criatura gains a +1 bonificador de estado to any prueba de habilidad in which estás entrenado, a +2 bonificador de estado if estás an experto, a +3 bonificador de estado if estás a maestro, or a +4 bonificador de estado if estás legendario. El criatura also takes a –2 penalización to all skills in which estás untrained.
Spellshape.WidenSpell: Si the next action tú use is to Lanzar un conjuro that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and does not have a duration, increase the area of that conjuro. Add 5 pies to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 pies (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 pies to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 pies long or smaller, and add 10 pies to the length of a larger cone or line.
Spellshape.WindTossedSpell: Ignoras el objetivo's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} estado and any cover they have from tú. El conjuro gains the air rasgo.

VitalityManipulationStance.Note:
Cuando usas Puño aturdidor, en lugar de salvar contra el aturdimiento, puedes elegir que el objetivo haga una salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)] contra tu CD de clase con los siguientes resultados. Debes elegir antes de que el objetivo haga su tirada de salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo no se ve afectado.

Éxito Los músculos del objetivo se debilitan temporalmente. Durante 1 asalto, el objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}, y cada vez que trata de llevar a cabo una acción con el rasgo manipulación, la acción se interrumpe a menos que tenga éxito en una prueba plana con una CD igual a 5 + su valor de debilitado.

Fallo Como éxito, pero la duración es de 1 minuto.

Fallo crítico Como éxito, pero la duración es de 1 minuto, la prueba plana es CD 11 y el objetivo sufre un penalizador -10 pies (3 m) por estatus a todas las Velocidades mientras dura.

Weretiger.Description: Obtienes a 25ft speed, a 1d8 piercing jaws ataque sin armas, and a 1d6 slashing claw ataque sin armas with the agile rasgo.
Weretiger.Label: Hombre tigre

Werewolf.Description: Obtienes a 30ft speed, and a 1d8 piercing jaws ataque sin armas with the trip rasgo.
Werewolf.Label: Hombre lobo

YouDontSmellRight.Label: Seek to determine if a criatura is disguised

BalancedLuck.Description: Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio, puedes elegir para una criatura a 15 pies (4,5 m) o menos de tu familiar entre un bonificador +1 por estatus a su CA o un penalizador -1 por estatus a su CA hasta el final de tu siguiente turno.
BalancedLuck.Title: Familiar de suerte equilibrada

FlowingScript.Description: Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio, las letras empiezan a cambiar rápidamente, causando una distracción. Hasta el final de tu siguiente turno, tu familiar puede proporcionarte flanqueo a ti y a tus aliados como si fuera capaz de atacar y tuviera un alcance de 5 pies (1,5 m); éste es un efecto visual.
FlowingScript.Title: Familiar de escritura fluida

FreezingRime.Description: Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio, puedes hacer que se forme hielo en una @Template[burst|distance:5]{explosión de 5 pies (1,5 m)} centrada en una casilla del espacio de tu familiar. Dichas casillas son terreno difícil hasta el inicio de tu siguiente turno.
FreezingRime.Title: Familiar de escarcha congeladora

KeenSenses.Description: Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio, tu familiar obtiene un sentido impreciso como olfato, sentido de la vibración o sentido de las olas, con un rango de distancia de 60 pies (18 m) hasta el inicio de tu siguiente turno y puede @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Señalar} de inmediato como una acción gratuita.
KeenSenses.Title: Familiar de sentidos agudos

NimbleFlight.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, tu familiar can Fly up to 15 pies; this movement no desencadena reacciones.
NimbleFlight.Title: Familiar de vuelo ágil

OngoingMisery.Description: Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio, tu familiar puede maldecir a una criatura a 15 pies (4,5 m) o menos de él, prolongando en 1 asalto la duración de cualquier estado negativo que le afecta. Éste es un efecto de maldición, que prolonga sólo estados con una duración mesurable en el tiempo (como por ejemplo "1 asalto" o "hasta el final de tu siguiente turno") y no evita que los estados se puedan eliminar de otra forma.
OngoingMisery.Title: Familiar de tristeza continuada

OverwhelmingTides.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, puedes cause a small wave to surge forth from tu familiar. One criatura a 10 pies o menos of tu familiar is pushed 5 pies away from tu familiar.
OverwhelmingTides.Title: Familiar de mareas arrolladoras

ParasiticMight.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, one criatura within 15 pies of tu familiar with less than half of its maximum Puntos de Golpe becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.spellDC.value)] tirada de salvación.
ParasiticMight.Title: Familiar de poder parasitario

RestoredSpirit.Description:
Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio, una criatura voluntaria a 15 pies (4,5 m) o menos de tu familiar obtiene tantos Puntos de
Golpe temporales como 2 + la mitad de tu nivel, que duran hasta el final de tu siguiente turno.
RestoredSpirit.Title: Familiar del espíritu restablecido

StalkingNight.Description: Cuando Lanzas o Mantienes un maleficio y tu familiar está adyacente a un enemigo del que no está @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} o no detectado,  el enemigo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.
StalkingNight.Title: Familiar de la noche acechante

BolsteringAid.Description: Tu familiar knows all manner of tricks that can help! Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, and tu familiar is adjacent to an aliado, that aliado gains a +2 bonificador de estado to the next non-attack prueba de habilidad that aliado attempts before the start of tu next turn.
BolsteringAid.Title: Familiar de ayuda reforzadora

EnticingNegotiation.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex and tu familiar is a 10 pies o menos of an enemigo, the enemigo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the start of tu next turn. Tu familiar can only distract a single enemigo per round in this way.
EnticingNegotiation.Title: Familiar de negociación tentadora

ObscuringSnowfall.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, puedes cause clinging snow to fall in a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] centered on a square of tu familiar's space. Esto snowfall remains until the start of tu next turn, and enemies that enter these squares during that period are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the start of tu next turn.
ObscuringSnowfall.Title: Familiar de nevada oscurecedora

PairedPerplexity.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, tu familiar seems to double and be in two places at once. One criatura tú elige within 20 pies of it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Estupefacto 1} until the start of tu next turn; this is a visual effect.
PairedPerplexity.Title: Familiar de perplejidad duplicada

SwarmsHeart.Description: Cuando tú Cast or Sustain a hex, the insects swarm to protect tú and tu aliados. Until the start of tu next turn, tu familiar grants concealment to tú or any aliado while sharing the same space.
SwarmsHeart.Title: Familiar de corazón de enjambre

Theme.FaithsFlamekeeper: Guardián de la llama de la fe

Seneschal.AdjustmentsAddendum: Instead of tu patron's lesson, obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqBfoUaWDennHYoZ]{Manifest Will} hex cantrip and tu familiar learns one common 1st-rank conjuro of tu choice from tu conjuro list.

SympatheticStrike.Note: Until the beginning of tu next turn, el objetivo takes a –1 penalización de circunstancia to its salvaciones contra tu hexes, or a –2 penalización if the triggering Golpe was a impacto crítico. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.qBTJYpopY3AwFFUJ]{Efecto: Sympathetic Golpe}

IronTeeth.Note: A criatura that tú critically hit with a jaws Golpe must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classDC.value)] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}.

ImprovedFamiliarAttunement.Description: Gastas the magical power stored in tu familiar. During el turno actual, puedes cast one conjuro tú prepared today and already cast, without spending a conjuro slot. Debes still Lanzar el conjuro and meet el conjuro's other requirements.
ImprovedFamiliarAttunement.Name: Drain Familiar
ImprovedFamiliarAttunement.Requisitos: Tu familiar is on tu person.

ArcaneBond.DescriptionAddendum: Runelords hail from an era where even a scholar was expected to be able to defend themself with arms if necessary, leading to the practice of attaching a blade to the typical wizard's staff. Debes elige a polearm or spear as tu arcane bond. In place of an arcane thesis, tienes a personal rune, which appears on tu bonded arma. El arma functions as a staff with charges equal to the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast and contains the sin conjuros from tu sin up to that rank (including tu cantrips). Tu personal rune isn't a property rune and doesn't count against the arma's limit of such runes. Si tú prepare a magical staff, it merges with tu bonded item until tu next daily preparations, adding its charges and conjuro list. While merged, the armas haft takes on aesthetic aspects of the staff.
ArcaneBond.Label: Arcane Bond and Personal Rune

Text.Damage: Tu poder espiritual erupts to punish tu enemies. Causas an additional 1d4 daño de espíritu with all Golpes and attack conjuros, and tu Golpes and attack conjuros gain the spirit rasgo.
Text.Description: Una vez al día when tú Unleash Yaoguai Might, puedes gain one of the following additional benefits, which persists durante 1 minuto or until tú Change Shape again.
Text.Enlarge: Tu cuerpo grows to impossible heights. Tu Enlarge effect is heightened to 4th rank.
Text.Fly: Puedes leap off the air itself. Obtienes los efectos de the *fly* conjuro.
Text.Frecuencia: Puedes Desatar el poder yaoguai cualquier número de veces al día.
Text.Title: **Legendary Monster**

UnleashYaoguaiMight.BornOfAnimal: **Animal** Tu piel thickens, granting a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to CA.
UnleashYaoguaiMight.BornOfCelestial: **Celestial** Recuperas some of tu celestial perfection, granting tú and all aliados within 15 pies a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de ataque.
UnleashYaoguaiMight.BornOfElements: **Elements** Estás surrounded in wind and dust, granting concealment each round that tú spend at least 1 action that has the move rasgo. Puedes't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak, as normal for sources of obvious concealment.
UnleashYaoguaiMight.BornOfItem: **Object** Tu piel transmutes partially into an inorganic substance, granting resistance 5 to tu choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.
UnleashYaoguaiMight.BornOfVegetation: **Vegetation** Desencadenas an accelerated growth, gaining curacion rapida 5.
UnleashYaoguaiMight.Description: As tú enter tu yaoguai form, tú draw upon tu internal magic to assume an even greater form. Cuando tú Change Shape to enter tu yaoguai form, puedes spend an additional action to gain the effects of Enlarge and an additional effect based on tu heritage. Esto effect persists durante 1 minuto or until tú Change Shape again.

Moodscales.Note: Si tú roll a success on a tirada de salvación against an emotion effect, tú get a critical success instead.

CutEmDeep.Note: Cuando tú successfully Demoralize el objetivo of tu @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]{Get 'Em!}, el objetivo doesn't become immune to tu further attempts to Demoralize them.

LeadByExample.DescriptionAlteration: Cuando tú use an act of leadership after issuing one or more envoy directives earlier that turn, puedes elige one envoy directive tú activated. Tú grant the lead by example benefits for that directive even if tú didn't meet the usual requirements to lead by example. Puedes do this once per turn.

EffortlessInfluencer.Note:
Cuando tú succeed at a check with Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation, aliados within 60 pies who witnessed tu success gain a +1 bonificador de estado to the next check they attempt with that skill within 1 minuto (or a +2 bonus if tu check was a critical success).

HangInThere.Éxito: El objetivo gains Puntos de Golpe temporales their level plus tu Charisma modifier. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.B4JhFkbk5WHmWcOZ]{Efecto: Hang In There!}

PardonMe.Note: Cuando tú successfully Tumble Through using Deception, the foe whose space tú passed through is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.estados.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suprimido} until the end of its next turn.

SavvyInfluencer.Note: El first time per day when tú roll a natural 1 on a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check, tú don't automatically reduce tu degree of success (tú get a critical failure only if tu result is 10 lower than the DC).

SmoothDiversions.Fallo: Las criaturas only become aware tú were trying to trick them if tú critically fail to Create a Diversion. Otherwise the criatura assumes that tu diversion was part of tu regular bravado.
SmoothDiversions.Éxito: Cuando tú succeed at an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, puedes immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} or Dar un paso as a free action.

Tactical.CriticalHit: On a impacto crítico while estás graviton attuned, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:31] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} durante 2 asaltos.
Tactical.Hit: Cuando tú hit an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} criatura with tu solar arma while graviton attuned, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:31] salvación or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Note.Tactical: On a impacto crítico while estás photon attuned, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:31] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} durante 2 asaltos.

EntropicDestabilizer.Note: Si el objetivo has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of daño persistente (its wielder rolls the prueba plana to see if the daño persistente ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike daño normal de vacío, the daño de vacío from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.

FearProjector.CriticalNoteCommercial: Cuando tú critically hit with this arma, el objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.
FearProjector.CriticalNoteTactical: Cuando tú critically hit with this arma, el objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

FrostModule.CriticalNoteTactical: On a impacto crítico, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of tu next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34] salvación.

HolyModule.CriticalNoteCommercial: On a impacto crítico, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} if unholy) until the end of tu next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] salvación.

Esto also prevents el objetivo from casting conjuros due to the incantations or sounds involved in casting, with the exception of subtle conjuros. El objetivo can resist the effects of the silencer with a successful @Check[will|dc:27] salvación.

Akashic.Harmony: Cuando tú Transfer Vitality, el objetivo receives a psychic download from the Akashic Record and can immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} as a reaction. Esto doesn't trigger any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when a criatura uses Recall Knowledge.
Akashic.PerfectHarmony: Creas an extradimensional memory palace that functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vPWMEyVTreMOoFnm]. Creating a door to the demiplane takes 1 minuto. El memory palace keeps the same layout each time tú access it, adjustable during daily preparations. Each phantasmal minion in tu memory palace functions as an akashic assistant (like those created by the *akashic assistant* conjuro).

ElementalBarrier.Air: Defending against electricity or daño sónico
ElementalBarrier.Earth: Defending against bludgeoning or daño perforante
ElementalBarrier.Metal: Defending against acid or daño cortante

Harmony.Addendum: Cuando tú Transfer Vitality, elige an elemental rasgo: air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. Si one or more of tu elemental epiphanies are active, debes select the elemental rasgo tú chose as part of casting those conjuros. Until the end of their next turn, el objetivo's next Golpe deals daño based on the chosen rasgo (tu choice), rather than its typical tipo de daño: electricity or sonic for air, bludgeoning or piercing for earth, acid or slashing for metal, fire for fire, bludgeoning or cold for water, or piercing or poison for wood.

PerfectHarmony.Addendum: Cuando tú heal a bonded aliado with Transfer Vitality, tu aliado gains resistance equal to half tu mystic level to the two daño types chosen during tu daily preparations until the beginning of tu next turn.

Harmony.Addendum: Cuando tú Transfer Vitality, attempt to counteract one affliction affecting el objetivo, or attempt to counteract one effect of tu choice imposing one of the following estados on el objetivo: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}.

PerfectHarmony.AddendumCounteract: In addition, if tú didn't counteract the effect, but tú would've if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of tu next turn. El effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

Harmony.Addendum: Cuando tú Transfer Vitality, el objetivo's shadow darkens and swells, reducing bright light within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of el objetivo to dim light. Esto is a form of magical darkness and can overcome non-magical light sources or attempt to counteract magical light. El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} while in this dim light and can use the concealed estado to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}. Esto lasts until the end of tu next turn.

PerfectHarmony.Addendum: Cuando tú Transfer Vitality, el objetivo can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.u9NU2bULHg3S5FaP]{Umbral Zancada} once before the end of their next turn.

EnhancedExploit.ReactionNote: Puedes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qbyer2woEdGXZzoR]{Sabotage} as a reaction siempre que a tech criatura or a criatura using a tech arma critically fails a melee tirada de ataque against tú, targeting the triggering criatura or arma.

EnhancedExploit.Note: Si tú fail tu first ranged Golpe against tu mark using a arma in the sniper arma group, tú Reload tu sniper arma as a free action. El Golpe doesn't count toward tu multiple attack penalización.

Promession.Note: El objetivo gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolled on its Fortitude save. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conjuro-effects.Item.Mjzoqg7MpTst3koD]{Spell Efecto: Promession}

UndeadSlayer.Note: Cuando tú succeed or critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge against an undead criatura that puedes see, tú identify a weak spot in their defenses—durante 1 minuto, obtienes access to the critical specialization effects of all armas and ataques sin armas for attacks tú make against that specific criatura.

kasatha.Description: Routine use of tu arms allows tú to quickly move held equipment around. Interactuarúas dos veces to draw, stow, or swap items tienes up to twice.

skittermander.Description: Routine use of tu arms allows tú to quickly move held equipment around. Interactuarúas dos veces to draw, stow, or swap items tienes up to twice.

shobhad.Description: Puedes efficiently move held equipment between tu four arms. Interactuarúas dos veces, using each to draw, stow, or swap items tienes.

ClingingBite.GrabAlteration: Sólo puedes usar Grab following a successful impacto crítico with tu jaws (rather than on a hit) or when tienes a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

AttunedWards.GravitonNote: El criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} durante 1 asalto. Esto increases to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} if this is the second time it hit tú this turn.
AttunedWards.Label: Attuned Wards

HarmonicConvergence.Alteration: Cuando tú use an action with the disharmony rasgo, obtienes a number of Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to half tu level.

NimbusSurge.GravitonNote: Si the Golpe is a critical success, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] salvación against tu class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn.
NimbusSurge.PhotonNote: Si the Golpe is a critical success, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] salvación against tu class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its turn.

ShatteringImpact.GravitonNote: On a hit, el objetivo takes a –10-pies penalización de estado to Velocidad until the start of tu next turn. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Ll3uZdiSqaszP3fn]{Efecto: Shattering Impact}

Graviton.Note: On a critical success, puedes attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} using tu Athletics even if tú don't have a free hand or are not adjacent to el objetivo.
Cuando tú successfully Golpe a criatura using tu solar arma, that criatura's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that criatura until the end of its next turn.

GravitonAttuned.Label: Graviton-Attuned
GravitonAttuned.Note: Cuando tú successfully Golpe a criatura using tu solar arma, that criatura treats all squares adjacent to the square where they were struck as being difficult terrain until the end of its next turn.

TwoHandToggle.TwinLabel: Twin Solar Weapon — Use two hands

StellarResilience.Note: Cuando tú roll a success on a Fortitude or Will save against a mental or incapacitation effect, puedes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]{Attune} as a free action.

ActionHero.AreaAddendum: Cuando tú Auto-Fire, the size of the cone is equal to the arma's full range increment, rather than half.
ActionHero.PrimaryTargetAddendum: Cuando using the Auto-Fire action, puedes designate a target anywhere in the cone to be tu primary target, rather than the criatura closest to tú.
ActionHero.RangedStrikeNote: Cuando tú successfully make a ranged Golpe with an automatic arma, tú @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.estados.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppress} el objetivo until the start of tu next turn.

ArmorStorm.Note: Cuando tú successfully Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip a criatura, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.estados.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suprimido} until the start of tu next turn.

Bombard.Note: Cuando tú attack with an area arma, puedes select a number of aliados within the area equal to half tu Constitution modifier. El selected aliados are unaffected by the attack. In addition, enemies who succeed (but not critically succeed) on their save against an area attack tú make are still @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.estados.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suprimido} until the start of tu next turn.

IntimidatingTaunt.Label: Intimidating Taunt
IntimidatingTaunt.SuccessAddendum: Only the first hostile action that the criatura takes is affected.

SuppressingFire.Note: Si tú make an attack with a arma that has the area rasgo, enemies in the affected area who fail their save against tu attack become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.estados.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suprimido} until the start of tu next turn.

BoomingBootloader.Alteration: All criaturas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around the criatura tú summoned take 1d4 daño sónico per conjuro rank (@Damage[((@item.level)d4)[sonic]]).

DebugSpell.Alteration: Any die tú roll for daño that has a result lower than 2 becomes a result of 2 instead.

DeleteRootAccess.Alteration: Replace *delete's* target with "one construct or tech criatura." Instead of delete's normal effects, el objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr] by tú if its level is equal to or lower than tu level – 3. It can attempt a Will tirada de salvación to resist being controlled by tú. Si el objetivo is already under someone else's command, the controlling criatura also rolls a tirada de salvación, and the construct uses the better result.

DegreeOfSuccess.CriticalFailure: **Fallo crítico** As failure, but the duration is 1 hora.
DegreeOfSuccess.CriticalSuccess: **Éxito crítico** El objetivo is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 horas.
DegreeOfSuccess.Fallo: **Fallo** El construct or tech criatura becomes a minion under tu control. El conjuro gains a duration of 1 minuto, but it is dismissed if tú or an aliado attacks the construct or tech minion.

GrenadeSpell.Alteration: Si tu next action is to Lanzar un conjuro with a burst effect that requires a Reflex save, el conjuro does not immediately take effect, but it instead is installed into the held grenade. Until the end of tu next turn, any criaturas caught in the Area Fire of the grenade are also affected by the installed conjuro; criaturas do not make a separate Reflex save against el conjuro and instead use the same result they rolled against the grenade.

HardlightIllusion.Alteration: Las criaturas cannot attempt to disbelieve tu illusion by merely touching or attempting to daño it, but they can still use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it and attempt to disbelieve tu illusion. Cuando a criatura succeeds (but not critically succeeds) at a Perception check or Will save to disbelieve the illusion, puedes reprogram it as a reaction by attempting a Computers check against el objetivo's Perception DC. Si tú succeed, el objetivo fails to disbelieve the illusion.

OvervoltResistor.Alteration: El conjuro ignores an amount of el objetivo's resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or daño sónico equal to tu level. Esto applies to all daño el conjuro deals, including daño persistente and daño caused by an ongoing effect of el conjuro, such as the wall created by wall of fire. A criatura's immunities are unaffected.

ShatterSpell.Alteration: Contrarrestas con éxito el objetivo, one criatura of tu choice occupying the same space as el conjuro effect or magic item takes daño de fuerza equal to 1d4 × el objetivo's counteract rank with a basic Reflex save against tu conjuro DC; if el objetivo has a rasgo corresponding to a type of daño, such as fire, this effect deals that daño instead of force.

SignalBoost.Alteration: Increase el conjuro's range by 30 pies. As is standard for increasing conjuro ranges, if el conjuro normally has a range of touch, tú extend its range to 30 pies.

SplitTunneling.Alteration: Puedes elegir a second target within range. Tiras a single tirada de ataque and compare the result to the CA of both targets. Esto counts as one attack for tu multiple attack penalización. To the second target, el conjuro deals only half the amount of daño it would normally deal for its degree of success, and it has no effects beyond el conjuro's initial daño (such as imposing estados or penalties).

SudoSpell.Alteration: El conjuro's energy reverberates and echoes. Puedes Lanzar el conjuro a second time before the end of tu next turn without expending a conjuro slot.

AnchoringStrike.CriticalSuccess: El Golpe gains the anchoring rasgo. Puedes reroll the dados de daño rolled for this strike, but debes use the second result, even if it's worse.
AnchoringStrike.Éxito: El Golpe gains the anchoring rasgo.

Analyst.QuantumField: Ves and understand infinite possibilities and complex theoretical equations as clearly as though they were etched into tu surroundings. Cuando tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, puedes apply the result against two related criaturas, hazards, unattended objects, and effects in tu quantum field. Siempre que sustain tu quantum field, puedes Seek or Recall Knowledge against an appropriate target in tu quantum field as a free action.

Anomaly.QuantumField: Tus movimientos blur as images of alternate iterations of tú flicker around tu current form, and tu speech echoes with a chorus of otherworldly sounds. Any time an enemigo within the quantum field attempts an action with the concentrate rasgo, the action is disrupted unless they succeed at a @Check[type:flat|dc:5].

GapInfluenced.QuantumField: Supernatural static swirls around tú, making thoughts slippery for those unaccustomed to tu presence. Estás @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} to criaturas within tu quantum field. Cuando a criatura within tu quantum field hits tú with an attack, tú lose this benefit against that criatura until the start of tu next turn.

Precog.QuantumField: Tienes a modicum of control of the flow of time that surrounds tú, allowing tú to speed yourself and others up, or decrease the flow of time for others. Un enemigo criatura that uses a move action inside tu quantum field takes a –5-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidad during that action. Tú y tus aliados gain a +5-pies bonificador de estado to Velocidad when tú use a move action inside tu quantum field during that action.

QuantumAnalysis.FortuneToggleLabel: Quantum Analysis — Attacking enemigo within Quantum Field
QuantumAnalysis.Label: Quantum Analysis
QuantumAnalysis.Note: Ignoras any prueba plana required due to the criatura being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, or behind cover.
